annotation: section B- her experience started in 2020, first with food conservation using salt or oil. But there was a fear of botulism if the technique was done wrong. Also explored  making kafir water and kombucha. This kombucha cultures traveled from porto to Basel when she moved. The techniques was transferred through communal workshops, in the commune that she was living in . She also inherited the kombucha culture of her friend that was moving away, inheriting her culture and documents of how to take care. The script in the food is a way to have people around, to share recipes, and memories. She comes from a diverse family with different cuisines and techniques. And uses food to recreate food memories when traveling using ingredients that you find. What is lost when a culture dies is how when her kefir died was helping with digestion and finding balance and that was lost when the culture died. Also the constant care for something is lost, which is also means a care for oneself is reduced.
